findings.source_quote:
The true thy chartered freemen are
  of every age and clime:
findings.suggested_fix:
Translate the sense of "chartered freemen" as people who are enfranchised or formally recognized members, not as something traded. Replace "verhandigde vryburgers" with a phrase like "gecharterde vryburgers" or "gepokte vryburgers" (better: "gecharterde vryburgers" or "geregistreerde vryburgers"). Keep the rest of the clause intact and idiomatic. Example replacement in translation: "Die getroues is jou gecharterde vryburgers
  uit elke ouderdom en klimaat:"
findings.translation_quote:
Die getroues is jou verhandigde vryburgers
  uit elke ouderdom en klimaat:

findings.suggested_fix: "high intent" here means "lofty/loftier purpose/aspiration", not "holy". Replace "heilige strewe" with an Afrikaans phrase that conveys "high/lofty intent", e.g. "hooggesinde strewe" or "hooggesinde doel". Example: "een standvastige, hooggesinde strewe;"

findings.source_quote:
How gleam thy watch-fires through the night
  with never-fainting ray!
findings.suggested_fix:
"never-fainting ray" should convey an ever-shining, unfading light. "onverslindende straal" is incorrect (means "unswallowing"). Replace with "onverflakkende straal" or "nooit-verswakende straal". Example: "Hoe flikker jou wagvure deur die nag
  met 'n onverflakkende straal!"
findings.translation_quote:
Hoe flikker jou wagvure deur die nag
  met onverslindende straal!
